data_sources: Official UCI N-BaIoT 442, raw 9 devices, 7 Mirai-covered clients
Independent official UCI RT-IoT2022 942, 5 simulated clients, two reciprocal normal-pattern orderings

family_selection.basis: Raw N-BaIoT development records only, primary safe_new, mean score across all three stages; prefer every-stage old/new FPR <=.10, otherwise highest predeclared score
family_selection.selected_additional_recipe: Best feasible non-baseline family; if baseline wins, retain best signed-log family as preprocessing ablation

main_replication.families: Frozen standard/norm and development-selected additional recipe
main_replication.seed0_raw_reuse: Include the already trained identical-budget development model once, not as an extra seed

full_budget_sensitivity.priority: After cross-dataset main replication; may remain incomplete at deadline

settings: candidate verification query fraction .25, clean approvals
approved-normal contamination target .05, full candidate queries
robustness_sensitivity.recipe: Same frozen primary family and main budget
robustness_sensitivity.controls: Ordinary new-only/replay and guarded/triggered policy; use the same actual observed label budget within each setting
robustness_sensitivity.protected_materials: Initial/old anchors and current-stage validation/calibration remain clean and available; contamination affects incoming approved training/reference only
robustness_sensitivity.priority: Only if time permits; never change settings in response to final performance

evaluation.final_access: Only after family/method/settings are frozen and corresponding training finishes; no changes after final opening
primary: actual optimizer steps and update accept/skip counts
evaluation.RT_secondary: Normal FPR by Thing/MQTT/Wipro; Wipro is final-only. Contradictory 107 rows retained exclusively in final metrics.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired learning seeds on shared device/row blocks; do not multiply evaluation repetitions into independent sample sizes
evaluation.limits: Raw N-BaIoT remains the same public captures; exact/coarse overlaps with earlier prepared CSV removed but not a new acquisition. RT is independent dataset with different numeric feature schema and virtual clients. No verified wall-clock timestamps.

time_rule: Prioritize matched raw/external seed cohorts. Stop launching work when estimated remaining duration would consume report/verification reserve. Report actual incomplete items; no favorable-seed dropping or hidden early truncation.
